verdict.rationale: Composio ships official Python/TS SDKs (composio.sessions.create, composio.mcp.create), a documented OpenAPI spec, and 'provider' adapters that convert Composio tools into native formats for any AI framework, plus a CLI for agent-native workflows — all clearly aimed at AI-native developers building programmatically. missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK ergonomics beyond first-party docs.
